attorneys: Frank C. Dailey, George E. Hershman, Othniel Hitch and Paul Y. Davis for appellants. Cleon H. Foust, Attorney General of Indiana, Winslow Van Horne, Karl J. Stipher, Deputy Attorneys General, and Louis B. Ewbank for appellees.

opinions.text:
